submitted.rationale: Index 8 (Sb 0.33) gave the highest measured EQE (0.0026%). XRD at this composition shows a mix of Cr2O3-like peaks (Q~2.55, 3.78) and rutile CrSbO4 (Q~1.93, 2.48). Nearby index 10 (Sb 0.39) was also positive (0.0014%). The Cr2O3-dominated side (index 3) and the rutile-only side (indices 14, 19) were at or below zero. Every value is near the noise floor at 2.1 eV illumination, so this ranking is weak.
